shifting-combatant.summary: Weapon-mastery tricks: knock pushed foes into each other and leap into crowds.

Domino Strike.summary: When a Push mastery hit shoves a creature into a space a Large or smaller creature fills, both make a DEX save (DC 8 + PB + the ability you raised) or take 1d10 Bludgeoning.

Fearless Leap.summary: After a running Long Jump (10+ ft first) that lands you within 5 ft of two or more enemies, attacks against you have Disadvantage until your next turn starts.

tactical-combatant.summary: A fighter's edge: temporary HP from a solid hit and a boost to a failed check.

Buffering Strike.summary: On a weapon hit, gain Temporary HP equal to the weapon's damage dice total. Usable again after you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

Honed Instincts.summary: After failing an ability check, add 1d6 to it, possibly making it succeed. Usable again after you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

pack-fighting.summary: Melee weapon attacks and Unarmed Strikes deal +1 damage when an ally that isn't Incapacitated is within 5 ft of the target, or +2 if such an ally there also has this feat.

prone-fighting.summary: Being Prone gives you no Disadvantage on attack rolls and grants attackers no Advantage against you.
